description: Three-phase panel multifunction meter (96x96 mm) with RS485 Modbus RTU, optional I/O and second port
source: CET, "PMC-53A Intelligent Multifunction Meter User Manual", V2.2 (2026-02-04), chapter 5 (protocol version 2.2)

sources.title: PMC-53A Intelligent Multifunction Meter User Manual

notes: Read with FC03, write with FC16; DO control also with FC05.
Big endian: high byte and high word first. Floats are IEEE 754.
Harmonic, TDD, unbalance and deviation values are sent as fractions (0.1 = 10 %); this map scales them to %.
Not in this map: max/min, max demand, monthly energy, freeze, SOE, data recorder and carbon emission logs, setpoint, data recorder, carbon and TOU set-up.
